label: WindySingleTabRadarFix
name: CardiacLens v9.10.347.159
notes: Fix Live Rain Radar so Windy opens in a single tab/window using the tested direct radar URL.
summary: Today’s Weather opens one Windy radar tab using https://www.windy.com/-Weather-radar-radar?radar,{latitude},{longitude},9. Current GPS is used when allowed; saved Weather ZIP coordinates are used as fallback.
whatsNew: Live Rain Radar now uses the tested Windy URL format: https://www.windy.com/-Weather-radar-radar?radar,{latitude},{longitude},9.
CardiacLens requests current GPS only when the radar button is tapped; if unavailable, it falls back to the saved Weather ZIP coordinates.
Help text explains why Windy was chosen while Open-Meteo remains the in-app forecast source.
fixes: Repairs duplicate-tab behavior caused by opening an about:blank tab that could not be reused after the GPS callback.
Keeps Open-Meteo as the in-app forecast source and Windy as the optional animated precipitation map.
changes: Live Rain Radar now opens Windy in a single named tab/window instead of leaving an about:blank tab and opening a second tab.
Preserves the tested Windy URL format: https://www.windy.com/-Weather-radar-radar?radar,{latitude},{longitude},9.
CardiacLens requests current GPS only when the radar button is tapped; if unavailable, it falls back to the saved Weather ZIP coordinates.
audit: Change isolated to Today’s Weather live radar link behavior, version metadata, service worker cache name, and related help/release text.
testing: Verified source contains one Windy URL builder and one Live Rain Radar handler.
Verified initial window open no longer uses noopener/noreferrer, allowing the GPS callback to update the same pending tab.
